svg.title: TYPE_READY_FOR_INSERT -> PlanReadyForInsertJob()
svg.desc: Put an empty tray into bay B21 and switch the bay to insert mode, so the next customer can drive in. The tray is chosen early, inside this method, when possible.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Only a bay in retrieve mode can be prepared for the next insert. In this example: B21 is READY_TO_RETRIEVE. (passes)", "Row 3. Work out the bay's inbound pose and whether a tray is already inside. In this example: B21 is empty. (no tray)", "Row 4. Empty bay: plan 'any empty tray -> this bay'. The tray is left blank for now. In this example: A TrayMove with a destination but no tray: '? -> B21'. (adds 1)", "Row 5. Bay holds a car: send it to a VECS first if it asked for charging, then plan an empty tray in. A car that did not ask for charging is moved later as a blocking tray. In this example: Not this case. A loaded tray that is not for charging stays put: DoTrayAssignments() later treats it as blocking the destination and moves it. (skipped)", "Row 6. Bay already holds an empty tray: nothing to move. In this example: Not this case. (skipped)", "Row 7. Try to fill the blank early: replay the DAG again and pick the nearest empty tray for this job's '? -> bay' moves. If none is found, leave it for tray assignment. In this example: Nearest empty tray by graph search: T23 (illustrative). Rule A is applied now for T23. If no tray is found, the move stays '? -> B21' for DoTrayAssignments(). (tray = T23)", "Row 8. Switch the bay to insert mode after the tray is in. In this example: After the tray is in. (adds 2 \u00b7 B)", "Row 9. Report success. In this example: (success)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): AGV-1 drives empty W27 -> W26 -> P23 and stops under T23 (the approach for event 1; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 1. AGV-1 lifts T23, carries it P23 -> W22 -> W41 -> B21 and lowers it.", "Playing the plan: event 2. B21 switches to READY_TO_INSERT. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
